findings.suggested_fix: Replace “konserwatiewe Anabaptistiese gemeenskappe” with “plain-gemeenskappe” (or another established Afrikaans equivalent that does not identify them specifically as Anabaptist).

findings.source_quote: “since it is their lot in life and we are too busy to be bothered”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise to preserve the source’s point that the church treats their struggle as simply their lot in life, while the church is too busy to be bothered; for example: “omdat hulle swaarkry as maar hul lot in die lewe beskou word en ons te besig is om ons daaraan te steur.”
findings.translation_quote: “omdat hulle glo dit is maar hoe die lewe vir hulle is en ons te besig is om ons daarmee te bemoei”

findings.source_quote: “leave sleeping dogs lie” or that it would be best to not “open that can of worms”
findings.suggested_fix: Use the idiomatic Afrikaans equivalent for not raising a troublesome issue, such as “laat slapende honde lê” and “maak nie daardie blikkie wurms oop nie.”
findings.translation_quote: “slapende honde te laat lê” or … “die wurmpies uit die blikkie te laat kom”
